app.name: Screendesk Screen Recording, Video Calls
app.short_description: Screen and camera recordings, video calls and AI resolution in every ticket.
app.long_description:
Let customers show you the issue instead of describing it. Screendesk puts screen recordings, video calls, booking links and AI resolution in every Zendesk ticket. Bug reports come with the video, and on your website with the console logs and network requests behind it. Trusted by 1,000+ customer-facing teams, and SOC 2 Type II compliant.

![Request a recording from the Screendesk app in a Zendesk ticket](https://app.screendesk.io/marketplace/zendesk/1-request-a-recording.gif)

**Request a screen recording in one click**  
From the ticket sidebar or the reply toolbar, Screendesk puts a recording link in your reply. Choose which website the customer records on, or video only.

![The customer records in the browser and the recording lands in the Zendesk ticket](https://app.screendesk.io/marketplace/zendesk/2-customer-records.png)

**Customers record with nothing to install, and the recording lands in the ticket**  
On a computer, your customer records their screen. On a phone, they film the product or the issue with the camera, front or back. No download, no account. Each recording is added as an internal note with the video and its full report, the ticket reopens, and every recording from that customer is listed in the sidebar.

![Console logs and network requests on the Screendesk recording page](https://app.screendesk.io/marketplace/zendesk/3-console-logs-and-network-requests.png)

**Console logs and network requests behind every bug report**  
On your own website (with the Screendesk snippet), recordings come with the console, network requests, browser and device. Auto blur hides sensitive data in recordings before anyone sees them.

![AI resolution with the likely cause and a suggested reply](https://app.screendesk.io/marketplace/zendesk/4-ai-resolution.png)

**AI resolution: the likely cause and a reply you can send**  
Screendesk reviews the ticket and the recording, then adds the likely cause and a suggested reply as an internal note, with the evidence behind it. AI summaries and transcripts tell you what a recording shows before you press play. Available on plans with AI resolution.

![Start a video call or send a booking link from the Zendesk reply toolbar](https://app.screendesk.io/marketplace/zendesk/5-video-calls-and-booking-links.png)

**Video calls and booking links**  
Start a video call with screen sharing from the ticket and the link goes in your reply. Everyone joins from the browser, and you can record the call. Or send a booking link so the customer picks a time from your team's calendars. You can also send a video back: record a response, or insert a saved one from your library.

### BUILT FOR ZENDESK

* Works in the ticket sidebar and the reply toolbar, in light and dark mode
* Tags for Zendesk Explore: screendesk-recording-requested, screendesk-recording-received, screendesk-recording-sent, screendesk-video-shared, screendesk-booking-link-shared, screendesk-live-screensharing
* Help Center and ticket forms: customers can attach a recording when they submit a request

### SECURITY AND COMPLIANCE

* SOC 2 Type II
* GDPR and CCPA compliant
* SAML SSO
* Restricted recording access
* Automatic data deletion
* Sensitive data masking

### YOUR DATA

* **In the panel**  
The app reads the ticket's number, the requester's email and your Zendesk email, to match you to your Screendesk workspace and list that customer's recordings.

* **With the access an admin allows when connecting**  
Screendesk adds internal notes and tags to tickets and reopens them when a recording arrives. With AI resolution on, it reads the ticket's conversation to suggest a reply. If an admin adds your solved tickets as a knowledge source, Screendesk imports them to find answers that worked before.

* **Stored by Screendesk**  
Recordings with their logs and reports, AI resolution results, the solved tickets an admin imports, and the access token for your Zendesk connection. AI features use Google Gemini, and your data isn't used to train AI models. Details are in our [privacy policy](https://screendesk.io/legal/privacy-policy).

Questions? Visit our [help center](https://docs.screendesk.io) or email support@screendesk.io.
app.installation_instructions:
1. Click **Install**.
2. Open any ticket and find **Screendesk** in the apps panel on the right. Pin it so it's always one click away.
3. Click **Connect workspace**. In the new tab, sign in to Screendesk or create an account with the same email you use in Zendesk, then allow access. A Screendesk admin only does this once, for the whole team.
4. Come back to Zendesk: the panel opens Screendesk by itself.
5. Invite your agents to your Screendesk workspace with the email they use in Zendesk.

Need help? Read the [setup guide](https://docs.screendesk.io/integrations/zendesk/install-and-set-up) or email support@screendesk.io.
